founder.name: Dmitriy Tychshenko
bio: I'm a software engineer with 15 years of experience. I founded Doge Consulting in 2015 and have since helped global and Tier-1 banks, a leading tax preparation software company, insurance and reinsurance providers, a global consumer device brand, and an AI-native commercial real estate startup ship software their teams rely on.
In my spare time I drum, cook, camp and spend time outdoors with my wife and kids.
